subject: Contract cadence: opt-out window, fallback language & execution plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Vectra redlines — opt-out window / termination for convenience

Team — looping you in early. Vectra sent redlines to the MSA + Order Form (attached below) and are pushing two asks that touch commercial risk: (1) shorten the auto-renew notice window from 60 -> 30 days (they want more flexibility), and (2) increase our termination-for-convenience cure/notice and add a service-transition assistance obligation.

Quick asks: 
- Laura: can you confirm where we are flexible on notice windows vs. where we need SLA/operational gating?
- Marissa / Rishi: if legal gives us a negotiable path, what impact on ARR/commit and what fallback language would you prefer for sales?

Attachments: Redlined_Order_Form_20261118.pdf, Vectra_MSARedline_20261118.docx (forwarded from the customer)

Thanks — Aditya

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 08:58 AM Vectra Procurement <procurement@vectrahealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Aditya / Redwood,
> 
> Attached are our redlines to the MSA and order form. Key commercial points: 30-day opt-out before renewal (down from 60), right to terminate for convenience with 45 days notice, and a 90-day transition assistance obligation (limited to knowledge transfer only). Please confirm if these are acceptable or provide alternative language.
>
> Regards,
> Samantha
> Vectra Health — Procurement
> Attachments: Vectra_MSARedline_20261118.docx, Redlined_Order_Form_20261118.pdf
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@vectrahealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: daniel.ruiz@vectrahealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:45:22 -0800
Subject: Vectra redlines: MSA + order form (submitted)

Aditya — thanks for the quick discussion earlier. We reviewed the standard MSA and have three preferences that matter to our board: 30-day auto-renew opt-out, termination for convenience with 45 days notice and pro-rated refund of prepaid fees, and a capped transition assistance obligation limited to 90 days and knowledge-transfer only.

I attached marked-up versions (docx + pdf). We'll be available to discuss this week. If there are specific clauses you consider non-starters, flag them and we can propose softer wording.

Best,
Samantha
Counsel, Vectra Health

Attachments: Vectra_MSARedline_20261118.docx, Redlined_Order_Form_20261118.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, samantha.cole@vectrahealth.com, daniel.ruiz@vectrahealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vectra redlines: MSA + order form (submitted)

Laura / Marissa — thanks Samantha. Quick operational notes for legal to consider so we can give the customer an answer by Monday: 
- 30-day opt-out: sales prefer this (easier close) but need to understand whether it creates churn monitoring burdens for Dedicated/Private deployments where long lead times exist.
- Termination for convenience: customer wants 45 days + pro-rated refund. We should avoid an open-ended refund obligation; sales prefers a phased refund schedule tied to unused committed capacity.
- Transition assistance: we can offer knowledge-transfer (docs + up to 4 engineer-days) but want to limit indemnities and avoid service-level obligations past the termination date.

Can legal draft two alternatives: (A) customer-friendly path (30d opt-out + 45d termination w/ pro-rata refund capped at 3 months of fees), and (B) our preferred fallback (45d notice stays, but refund limited to unused prepaid amounts and transition limited to 30 days and knowledge-transfer only). 

I'll propose a 30-minute call with Samantha + Daniel and legal Monday morning to walk options.

Thanks — Aditya
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: samantha.cole@vectrahealth.com, daniel.ruiz@vectrahealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vectra redlines: MSA + order form (submitted) — legal analysis and suggested language

Team / Samantha — reviewed the redlines. Summary and proposed two-track language below. High level: we can accept a 30‑day opt-out in the MSA for standard hosted/hosted-api deals, but for Dedicated/Private (where committed capacity or long deploy windows apply) we need explicit carveouts so we don't face immediate capacity reallocation and stranded costs. Term-for-convenience draft notes below balance customer expectation with Redwood's exposure: capped refunds, explicit mitigation, and a short transition assistance description.

Proposed (A) Customer-friendly (accept if deal < $100k ARR or hosted only):
- Auto-renew: "Either party may provide written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current Term."
- Termination for convenience: "Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon forty-five (45) days' prior written notice. Customer will be entitled to a pro-rata refund of any prepaid fees for Services not yet provided, capped at the equivalent of three (3) months of fees (the \"Refund Cap\")."
- Transition assistance: "Upon termination for convenience, Redwood will provide knowledge-transfer services limited to documentation and up to ninety (90) days of reasonable transition assistance not to exceed four (4) Redwood engineer-days. Redwood shall have no obligation to continue hosting services beyond the effective date of termination except as required to perform transition assistance."

Proposed (B) Redwood-preferred fallback (standard for Dedicated/Private or > $100k ARR):
- Auto-renew: "Auto-renewal shall be subject to the customer's obligation to provide written non-renewal notice at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current Term, except that the parties may agree in an Order Form to a shorter notice period for hosted-only Services."
- Termination for convenience: "Either party may terminate for convenience upon forty-five (45) days' prior written notice; refunds, if any, shall be limited to unused prepaid fees and shall exclude any committed capacity charges, decommissioning costs, or third-party pass-throughs. Any refund shall be subject to a mitigation offset for costs reasonably incurred by Redwood in connection with the Agreement."
- Transition assistance: "Redwood will provide knowledge-transfer and reasonable transition assistance for a period not to exceed thirty (30) days and five (5) engineer-days. Any additional transition support shall be subject to a mutually agreed statement of work and fees."

Risk flags: 
- Committed GPU reservations and Dedicated pools — short notice without carveouts will create material cost exposure.
- Refund Cap helps commercial predictability; open-ended pro-rata refunds are high risk.

Suggested next steps: 
1) Aditya to run revenue sensitivity if we accept (A) for this deal; Marissa to confirm revenue impact and whether we can absorb a 3‑month refund cap.
2) If (A) acceptable, legal to prepare a tracked redline with (A) language for the MSA + Order Form. If not, present (B) with explicit carveouts for Dedicated/Private.
3) 30-minute negotiation call Monday 11/22 09:30 PST — please confirm availability.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: samantha.cole@vectrahealth.com, daniel.ruiz@vectrahealth.com

Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vectra redlines: MSA + order form (submitted) — next steps

Samantha / Daniel — thanks for the redlines and for your patience while we reviewed internally. Plan: 
1) Laura has provided two alternate language sets (customer-friendly and Redwood-preferred). We think customer-friendly (A) is reasonable for a hosted-only implementation and would help accelerate signing. For Dedicated/Private or deals with larger committed spend, we will rely on (B) with carveouts for committed capacity.
2) Marissa and I are running a quick ARR impact check — if the deal is below $100k ARR we can move forward with (A) with the 3-month refund cap. If above, we will present (B) with a targeted compromise: 30-day opt-out for hosted components, 60-day for Dedicated, and refund cap equal to 3 months or unused prepaid fees, whichever is lower.

Proposed short call to finalize: Tue 11/23 09:30 PST (30 min). If that works, we'll send a calendar invite and a tracked redline of the MSA + Order Form reflecting (A) and (B) variants for your review.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
